records.title: Content hierarchy
records.summary: Make the user's next question visible in headings, grouping, and reading order; do not rely on size or color alone.

records.title: Data context
records.summary: Show units, time range, source or freshness, and comparison context near important measurements.

records.title: Comparison integrity
records.summary: Compare like with like; disclose assumptions, total cost, ranges, and missing values that can change a decision.

records.title: Recovery and reversibility
records.summary: Explain errors in context, preserve entered work, and give a clear route to retry, undo, or get help.

records.title: Filter state
records.summary: Keep active filters, result count, clear-all, and no-results recovery understandable and keyboard operable.

records.title: Truthful content
records.summary: Mark illustrative content, avoid invented proof or precision, and keep claims traceable to supplied facts.

records.title: Input and result feedback
records.summary: Make constraints, defaults, validation, processing, and result updates perceivable without requiring color or motion.

records.title: Accessible controls
records.summary: Provide visible focus, semantic names, sufficient target size, keyboard operation, and reduced-motion behavior.
